name: @sleepymug/fleet-box
description: What runs in each of fleet's boxes, its helper, which dials the gateway and serves the box's processes, terminals and files over that tunnel, and the box's services to its programs; and the image, Node with the helper on top

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
